main.description: Hand off a formed colony (or single signal) to ki for vertical synthesis. Analogous to bacterial → vascular plant horizontal-gene-transfer hand-off — saikin releases its assembled context for ki to absorb. One of colonyId or signalId is required.

colonyId.description: Colony to hand off (preferred). Resolved against vertex_saikin_colony.

signalId.description: Single signal to hand off if no colony is available. Resolved against vertex_saikin_signal.

kiAbsorbVertexId.description: AT URI of the seeded vertex_ki_absorb row (at://{ki_did}/com.etzhayyim.apps.ki.absorb/{kiAbsorbId}).
